_about: Free public endpoints without an API key, in the order scripts/pubnet.py and scripts/pubnet.sh try them. Probed read-only on 2026-11-18 16:17-16:20Z (python3 -I scripts/pubnet.py probe <network>); e2e/NETWORK.md has the results and the endpoints that did not answer. A script's own endpoint (the Secret's SEPOLIA_RPC_URL) goes first; a local one is the only one; PUBNET_<NETWORK>_RPC / _BEACON / _BEACON_LC (comma-separated) replace a list (tests). beacon_lc: the ones that serve the light-client routes (/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/...).
